name: alert
description: One announced disruption in a big German city that parents should know about before going out.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: assembly = a registered demonstration or march from an official list; police_notice = a police press release about demos, big operations, evacuations or closures; transit = a transit operator's notice; strike = a strike notice.

fields.name: published
fields.description: When the source published it. Old press releases are out of scope.

fields.name: start_date
fields.description: The day it happens, when the source says so.

fields.name: route
fields.description: The march route (Aufzugsstrecke), when there is one; a march disrupts much more than a standing rally.

fields.name: _source
fields.description: Provenance: source_id, url, retrieved_at, mode, attribution.
